scenes.text: The core rule is routing. Jo's twenty-four hundred dollar laptop goes to Maya, her manager, then to Ana in Finance, because it's over a thousand dollars. And nobody approves their own request.
That loop broke routing. The spec also never said what happens when an approver is inactive, or if the reminder clock restarts after a reassignment. All nine gaps are now fixed.
But passing every check isn't production-ready. We didn't test real sign-in, a live Slack workspace, email, or hosting.
